text: Next, define functions determine catches constrained translate fishing mortality within closed-loop simulation. general, helper functions establish feedback catch advice operating model. first function applies management rules constraints (.e., caps) total allowable catch (TAC). constraints applied user-specified function catch_opt_func, modifies input catch advice based management procedures defined later. next function converts (possibly constrained) TAC corresponding fishing mortality rate (Fmort) used operating model. function uses bisection algorithm find value fishing mortality achieves specified TAC region fleet combination. updated Fmort values stored simulation environment use next time step closed-loop cycle.
code: #' Apply Catch Constraints #' #' Applies management procedure catch constraints (e.g., caps) to projected catch. #' #' @param tmp_TAC Array of projected TAC values #' @param catch_opt_func Function defining catch constraints #' #' @return Modified TAC array with constraints applied apply_catch_constraints <- function(tmp_TAC, catch_opt_func) {   for (j in 1:dim(tmp_TAC)[3]) {     tmp_TAC[1,, j,1, ] <- catch_opt_func(catch = tmp_TAC[1,, j,1, ])   }   return(tmp_TAC) } #' Convert TAC to Fishing Mortality #' #' Uses bisection method to find fishing mortality rate that achieves target TAC. #' #' @param sim_env Simulation environment #' @param tmp_TAC Target total allowable catch #' @param y Current year index #' @param sim Simulation replicate index #' @param assessment_years Vector of assessment year indices #' #' @return Updated simulation environment with new fishing mortality rates tac_to_fmort <- function(sim_env, tmp_TAC, y, sim, assessment_years) {    # Find most recent assessment year   last_assess_year <- max(assessment_years[assessment_years <= y])   tac_year_index <- y - last_assess_year + 1    # Create grid of region-fleet combinations   rf_grid <- expand.grid(     r = seq_len(sim_env$n_regions),     f = seq_len(sim_env$n_fish_fleets)   )    # Solve for F that achieves target catch for each region-fleet combination   tmp_f <- mapply(     function(r, f) {       SPoRC::catch_to_F_singlefleet(         f_guess = 0.05,         catch = tmp_TAC[1, r, tac_year_index, 1, f],         NAA = sim_env$NAA[1, r, y + 1, 1, , , sim],         WAA = sim_env$WAA[1, r, y + 1, 1, , , sim],         natmort = sim_env$natmort[1, r, y + 1, , , sim],         fish_sel = sim_env$fish_sel[1,r, y + 1, 1, , , f, sim]       )     },     r = rf_grid$r,     f = rf_grid$f   )    # Update fishing mortality in simulation environment   sim_env$Fmort[, y + 1, 1, , sim] <- array(tmp_f, dim = c(sim_env$n_regions, sim_env$n_seas, sim_env$n_fish_fleets))    return(sim_env) }

title: Testing Management Procedures via Closed Loop Simulations (Dusky Rockfish)
text: MPs define catch advice generated applied within closed-loop simulation. MP defined includes rules reference point calculation, control rule shape, catch implementation. helper functions specify shape control rules used across different MPs. threshold rule reduces fishing mortality spawning biomass declines biomass reference point, constant rule maintains fishing mortality fixed rate regardless biomass status. list defines specific MPs used example. configuration represents different management strategy, varying strongly responds changes biomass whether catch caps imposed. MP following components example: Reference point options (reference_points_opt), specify biological reference points calculated (e.g., target spawning potential ratio, biomass thresholds). Projection options (proj_opt), define harvest control rule (HCR) recruitment fishing mortality handled projections. Catch options (catch_opt), optionally constrain catches according management limits (e.g., catch caps). Users flexibility modify extend structure fit specific modeling objectives.
code: #' Threshold Harvest Control Rule #' #' Implements a threshold HCR where F is reduced linearly as biomass declines #' below the target biomass reference point. #' #' @param x Current biomass #' @param frp Fishing mortality reference point (target F) #' @param brp Biomass reference point (target biomass) #' @param alpha Minimum biomass threshold (as fraction of brp) #' #' @return Fishing mortality rate HCR_threshold <- function(x, frp, brp, alpha = 0.05) {   stock_status <- x / brp    if (stock_status >= 1) {     f <- frp   } else if (stock_status > alpha) {     f <- frp * (stock_status - alpha) / (1 - alpha)   } else {     f <- 0   }    return(f) }  #' Constant Harvest Control Rule #' #' Implements a constant catch HCR where F remains at the reference level #' regardless of stock status. #' #' @param x Current biomass (unused) #' @param frp Fishing mortality reference point (target F) #' @param brp Biomass reference point (unused) #' @param alpha Minimum biomass threshold (unused) #' #' @return Fishing mortality rate (constant at frp) HCR_constant <- function(x, frp, brp = 0, alpha = 0.05) {   return(frp) } assess_freq <- 2           # Assessment frequency (every 2 years)  mp_list <- list(    # 1. No fishing   # Serves as a baseline scenario. No assessment, projection, or catch is applied.   f0 = list(     skip_assessment = TRUE,     reference_points_opt = NULL,     proj_opt = NULL,     catch_opt = NULL   ),    # 2. F40% with B40% threshold   # The assessment is performed and reference points are calculated based on an SPR of 40%.   # A threshold rule (B40%) is applied, where F declines linearly as biomass drops below 40% of B_SPR.   f40_thresh = list(     skip_assessment = FALSE,     reference_points_opt = list(       n_avg_yrs = 1,       SPR_x = 0.4,       calc_rec_st_yr = 3,       rec_age = 4,       type = 'single_region',       what = "SPR",       B_x = 0.4     ),     proj_opt = list(       n_proj_yrs = assess_freq + 1,       HCR_function = HCR_threshold,       recruitment_opt = 'mean_rec',       fmort_opt = 'HCR',       bh_rec_opt = NULL     ),     catch_opt = function(catch, prev_catch = NULL, catch_cap = NULL) catch   ),    # 3. F40% constant   # Similar to f40_thresh, but no biomass threshold is applied.   # Fishing mortality remains constant at F40%, regardless of biomass status.   f40_const = list(     skip_assessment = FALSE,     reference_points_opt = list(       n_avg_yrs = 1,       SPR_x = 0.4,       calc_rec_st_yr = 3,       rec_age = 4,       type = 'single_region',       what = "SPR",       B_x = NULL     ),     proj_opt = list(       n_proj_yrs = assess_freq + 1,       HCR_function = HCR_constant,       recruitment_opt = 'mean_rec',       fmort_opt = 'HCR',       bh_rec_opt = NULL     ),     catch_opt = function(catch, prev_catch = NULL, catch_cap = NULL) catch   ),    # 4. F40% hybrid: B60% threshold with 3k ton catch cap   # Combines a precautionary threshold (B60%) with a hard catch cap (3,000 tons).   # This MP reduces F more aggressively at lower biomass and constrains annual catches   # to prevent excessive harvest in high-recruitment years.   f40_hybrid = list(     skip_assessment = FALSE,     reference_points_opt = list(       n_avg_yrs = 1,       SPR_x = 0.4,       calc_rec_st_yr = 3,       rec_age = 4,       type = 'single_region',       what = "SPR",       B_x = 0.6     ),     proj_opt = list(       n_proj_yrs = assess_freq + 1,       HCR_function = HCR_threshold,       recruitment_opt = 'mean_rec',       fmort_opt = 'HCR',       bh_rec_opt = NULL     ),     catch_opt = function(catch, prev_catch = NULL, catch_cap = 3000) {       pmin(catch, catch_cap)     }   ) )

title: Testing Management Procedures via Closed Loop Simulations (Dusky Rockfish)
text: core closed-loop simulation involves iterating years replicates simulate population dynamics, assessments, management feedback. simulation year, population updated according biological processes, recruitment, fishing mortality. feedback period reached, management procedures applied based latest assessment results , cases, skipped MP specifies fishing (e.g., F = 0). Assessment model inputs prepared using setup_em helper, model fit available data (via fit_model). assessment complete, reference points calculated, forward projections run, catch advice determined. Catch constraints caps can applied converting advice true fishing mortality rates used operating models next year. single-replicate loop serves building block running multiple replicates parallel, allowing us evaluate robustness performance different MPs repeated simulations.
code: #' Run Single Simulation Replicate #' #' Executes one complete closed-loop simulation replicate including population #' dynamics, assessments, and management feedback. #' #' @param sim Simulation replicate index #' @param sim_list Simulation configuration list #' @param mp_config Management procedure configuration #' @param assessment_years Vector of years when assessments occur #' @param years_to_use Vector of years with available data #' @param assess_freq Assessment frequency (years) #' #' @return List containing simulation results (SSB, catch, F, NAA) run_single_replicate <- function(sim, sim_list, mp_config, assessment_years,                                  years_to_use, assess_freq) {      # Initialize simulation environment   sim_env <- Setup_sim_env(sim_list)    # Loop through all simulation years   for (y in 1:sim_env$n_yrs) {          # Execute annual population dynamics     run_annual_cycle(y, sim, sim_env)      # Management feedback loop (after burn-in period)     if (y >= sim_env$feedback_start_yr) {       # Check if MP skips assessments (e.g., F=0)       if (!is.null(mp_config$skip_assessment) && mp_config$skip_assessment) {         if (y < sim_env$n_yrs) sim_env$Fmort[, y + 1, , , sim] <- 0       } else {         # Normal assessment and management procedure         if (y %in% assessment_years) {           # Prepare estimation model inputs           dusky_input_list <- setup_em(sim_env, y, sim)           asmt_data <- dusky_input_list$data           parameters <- dusky_input_list$par           mapping <- dusky_input_list$map            # Set indicators for unused data years to 0           asmt_data <- SPoRC::set_data_indicator_unused(             data = asmt_data,             unused_years = setdiff(1:sim_env$n_yrs, years_to_use),             what = c("FishIdx", "FishAgeComps", "SrvIdx", "SrvAgeComps", "FishLenComps", "SrvLenComps")           )            # Fit assessment model with error handling           fit_result <- tryCatch({             SPoRC::fit_model(               asmt_data, parameters, mapping,               random = NULL, newton_loops = 1, silent = TRUE             )           }, error = function(e) {             message(sprintf("Model fit failed for replicate %d in year %d: %s",                             sim, y, e$message))             return(NULL)           })            # If model fitting failed, return NA results           if (is.null(fit_result)) {             return(list(               sim = sim,               rec = NA,               ssb = NA,               catch = NA,               fmort = NA,               naa = NA,               failed = TRUE,               failure_year = y             ))           }            obj <- fit_result            # Calculate biological reference points           reference_points <- SPoRC::get_closed_loop_reference_points(             use_true_values = FALSE,             sim_env = sim_env,             asmt_data = asmt_data,             asmt_rep = obj$rep,             y = y,             sim = sim,             reference_points_opt = mp_config$reference_points_opt,             n_proj_yrs = mp_config$proj_opt$n_proj_yrs           )            # Run forward projections           proj <- run_projection(sim_env, obj, reference_points, asmt_data, mp_config, y)            # Apply catch constraints (e.g., caps)           tmp_TAC <- apply_catch_constraints(             proj$proj_Catch[1,, -1, 1, , drop = FALSE],             mp_config$catch_opt           )         }          # Convert TAC to fishing mortality for next year         if (y < sim_env$n_yrs) {           sim_env <- tac_to_fmort(sim_env, tmp_TAC, y, sim, assessment_years)         }       }     }   }    # Return successful replicate results   list(     sim = sim,     rec = sim_env$Rec[,,,sim,drop = FALSE],     ssb = sim_env$SSB[,, , sim, drop = FALSE],     catch = sim_env$TrueCatch[,, , , sim, drop = FALSE],     fmort = sim_env$Fmort[,, , , sim, drop = FALSE],     naa = sim_env$NAA[,,, , , , sim, drop = FALSE],     failed = FALSE   ) }

text: efficiency, simulations can executed parallel across multiple management procedures replicates. run_parallel_simulations function sets parallel cluster, exports necessary functions objects, runs replicate simultaneously. Results replicate collected stored arrays spawning biomass, catch, fishing mortality, numbers--age. Users can modify custom manner extract additional results necessary unique applications.
code: #' Run Parallel Simulations #' #' Executes multiple management procedures in parallel across all replicates. #' #' @param mp_list List of management procedure configurations #' @param sim_list Simulation configuration list #' @param n_cores Number of CPU cores to use  #' #' @return List of simulation results for each management procedure run_parallel_simulations <- function(mp_list, sim_list, n_cores = max(1, detectCores() - 2)) {    # Initialize parallel cluster   cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)   registerDoParallel(cl)    # load in packages   clusterEvalQ(cl, {     library(SPoRC)     library(here)   })    # export functions in env   clusterExport(     cl,     c("sim_list", "assessment_years", "years_to_use", "assess_freq",       "setup_em", "run_projection", "apply_catch_constraints",       "tac_to_fmort", "run_single_replicate"),     envir = environment()   )    # init results storage   sim_res <- vector("list", length(mp_list))   names(sim_res) <- names(mp_list)    # loop through each management procedure   for (i in seq_along(mp_list)) {      message(sprintf(       "Running MP %d/%d: %s on %d cores with %d replicates",       i, length(mp_list), names(mp_list)[i], n_cores, sim_list$n_sims     ))      # export MP to par env     current_mp_config <- mp_list[[i]]     current_mp_name <- names(mp_list)[i]     clusterExport(cl, c("current_mp_config", "current_mp_name"), envir = environment())      # run replicates in parallel     replicate_results <- parLapply(cl, 1:sim_list$n_sims, function(sim) {        set.seed(123 + sim)         tryCatch({         run_single_replicate(           sim = sim,           sim_list = sim_list,           mp_config = current_mp_config,           assessment_years = assessment_years,           years_to_use = years_to_use,           assess_freq = assess_freq         )       }, error = function(e) {         list(error = TRUE, message = as.character(e), sim = sim)       })     })      # get dimensions from first replicate     n_regions <- dim(replicate_results[[1]]$ssb)[2]     n_years <- dim(replicate_results[[1]]$ssb)[3]     n_ages <- dim(replicate_results[[1]]$naa)[5]     n_sexes <- dim(replicate_results[[1]]$naa)[6]     n_fish_fleets <- dim(replicate_results[[1]]$fmort)[4]      # init result arrays     sim_res[[i]] <- list(       mp_name = names(mp_list)[i],       rec = array(dim = c(n_regions, n_years, sim_list$n_sims)),       ssb = array(dim = c(n_regions, n_years, sim_list$n_sims)),       catch = array(dim = c(n_regions, n_years, n_fish_fleets, sim_list$n_sims)),       fmort = array(dim = c(n_regions, n_years, n_fish_fleets, sim_list$n_sims)),       naa = array(dim = c(n_regions, n_years, n_ages, n_sexes, sim_list$n_sims))     )      # populate result arrays from replicate results     for (sim in 1:sim_list$n_sims) {       sim_res[[i]]$rec[, , sim] <- replicate_results[[sim]]$rec[1,,,]       sim_res[[i]]$ssb[, , sim] <- replicate_results[[sim]]$ssb[1,,,]       sim_res[[i]]$catch[, , , sim] <- replicate_results[[sim]]$catch[,,1,,]       sim_res[[i]]$fmort[, , , sim] <- replicate_results[[sim]]$fmort[,,1,,]       sim_res[[i]]$naa[, , , , sim] <- replicate_results[[sim]]$naa[1,,-n_years,1,,,1]     }    }    # reset parallel cluster   stopCluster(cl)    return(sim_res) }

BH recruitment with crash R0 R0_input[,,71:98] <- 12 # BH recruitment with rebound R0 R0_input <- replicate(n = n_sims, R0_input)  # setup h input to mimic crash scenario h_input <- array(0, dim = c(n_pop, n_regions, n_years + closed_loop_yrs)) h_input[,,1:47] <- 0.999 # mean recruitment from EM h_input[,,48:70] <- 0.5 # steepness in crash h_input[,,71:98] <- 0.75 # steepness in rebound h_input <- replicate(n = n_sims, h_input)  sim_list_crash <- condition_closed_loop_simulations(   closed_loop_yrs = closed_loop_yrs,   n_sims = n_sims,   data = data,   parameters = parameters,   mapping = mapping,   sd_rep = sd_rep,   rep = rep,   random = NULL,   recruitment_opt = 'bh_rec',   ISS_FishAgeComps_fill = "F_pattern",   ISS_FishLenComps_fill = "F_pattern",   R0_input = R0_input,   h_input = h_input )  # Define assessment and data years assessment_years <- seq(sim_list_rand$feedback_start_yr, sim_list_rand$n_yrs, assess_freq) years_to_use <- c(burnin_years, seq(sim_list_rand$feedback_start_yr, sim_list_rand$n_yrs, data_yr_freq))

code: for(i in 1:length(sim_all)) {    # extract out recruitment scenario   sim_tmp <- sim_all[[i]]    # get mp specific results   for(j in 1:length(sim_tmp)) {     # get ssb     tmp_ssb <- reshape2::melt(sim_tmp[[j]]$ssb) %>%       rename(Region = Var1, Year = Var2, Sim = Var3, SSB = value) %>%       mutate(MP = sim_tmp[[j]]$mp_name,              Scenario = names(sim_all)[i])      # get summary statistics for time series sumry <- ssb_results %>% # ssb   group_by(MP, Year, Scenario) %>%   summarize(median = median(SSB),             lwr = quantile(SSB, 0.025),             upr = quantile(SSB, 0.975)) %>%   mutate(Type = 'Spawning Stock Biomass') %>%   bind_rows(     catch_results %>% # catch       group_by(MP, Year, Scenario) %>%       summarize(median = median(cat),                 lwr = quantile(cat, 0.025),                 upr = quantile(cat, 0.975)) %>%       mutate(Type = 'Catch')   ) %>%   bind_rows(     f_results %>% # fishing mortality       group_by(MP, Year, Scenario) %>%       summarize(median = median(f),                 lwr = quantile(f, 0.025),                 upr = quantile(f, 0.975)) %>%       mutate(Type = 'Fishing Mortality')   ) %>%   bind_rows(     rec_results %>% # recruitment       group_by(MP, Year, Scenario) %>%       summarize(median = median(Rec),                 lwr = quantile(Rec, 0.025),                 upr = quantile(Rec, 0.975)) %>%       mutate(Type = 'Recruitment')   ) %>%   mutate(Year = Year + 1976,          Period = ifelse(Year <= 2024, "Historical", "Feedback"),          MP = factor(MP, levels = c("f0", "f40_thresh", "f40_const", "f40_hybrid")),          Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = c("rand", "crash")))  # Calculate summary statistics across entire feedback period from raw data period_summary <- ssb_results %>%   filter(Year > 2024 - 1976) %>%  # feedback period (Year is relative to 1976)   group_by(MP, Scenario) %>%   summarize(     median = median(SSB),     lwr = quantile(SSB, 0.025),     upr = quantile(SSB, 0.975),     .groups = 'drop'   ) %>%   mutate(Type = 'Spawning Stock Biomass') %>%   bind_rows(     catch_results %>%       filter(Year > 2024 - 1976) %>%       group_by(MP, Scenario, Sim) %>%       mutate(         catch_mean = mean(cat, na.rm = TRUE),         aav = if_else(catch_mean == 0, 0, abs((cat - lag(cat)) / catch_mean))       ) %>%       group_by(MP, Scenario) %>%       summarize(         median = median(aav, na.rm = TRUE),         lwr = quantile(aav, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),         upr = quantile(aav, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),         .groups = 'drop'       ) %>%       mutate(Type = 'AAV')   ) %>%   bind_rows(     rec_results %>%       filter(Year > 2024 - 1976) %>%       group_by(MP, Scenario) %>%       summarize(         median = median(Rec),         lwr = quantile(Rec, 0.025),         upr = quantile(Rec, 0.975),         .groups = 'drop'       ) %>%       mutate(Type = 'Recruitment')   ) %>%   bind_rows(     catch_results %>%       filter(Year > 2024 - 1976) %>%       group_by(MP, Scenario) %>%       summarize(         median = median(cat),         lwr = quantile(cat, 0.025),         upr = quantile(cat, 0.975),         .groups = 'drop'       ) %>%       mutate(Type = 'Catch')   ) %>%   mutate(MP = factor(MP, levels = c("f0", "f40_thresh", "f40_const", "f40_hybrid")))

Across MPs, trade-offs apparent: rand recruitment scenario, catch remained stable, lower harvest capped MPs (f40_hybrid) higher harvest uncapped MPs. title: Specifying a Natal Homing Model
text: Movement parameterized two seasons three populations. seasonal structure captures two distinct behavioral phases: Season 1 (dispersal): diffusive mixing, population moderate probability remaining current region, remainder spread uniformly regions. Season 2 (natal return): strong homing back natal region small rate homing natally. proportion individuals natally home, stray rate specified represent components population temporarily transfer population memerbship. default, set 0, thus, individuals stray. Rather, individuals natally home essentially represent skipped spawning (.e., contribute spawning biomass). Note populations 1 2 different dispersal retention probabilities (0.7 vs 0.3) despite sharing natal region, creating distinct mixing dynamics two co-occurring populations.
code: sim_list$Movement <- array(   0,   dim = c(sim_list$n_pop, sim_list$n_regions, sim_list$n_regions,           sim_list$n_yrs, sim_list$n_seas, sim_list$n_ages,           sim_list$n_sexes, sim_list$n_sims) )  # Fill in movement matrix stay_prob <- c(0.7, 0.3, 0.7)  # probability of staying in current region during dispersal season disperse_prob <- (1 - stay_prob) / (sim_list$n_regions - 1)  # spread remainder equally non_natal_rate <- 0.15 # non natal homing rate  for (p in seq_len(sim_list$n_pop)) {   nr <- sim_list$natal_region[p]   for (r_from in seq_len(sim_list$n_regions)) {      # Season 1: diffusive dispersal, mostly stay, some movement out     for (r_to in seq_len(sim_list$n_regions)) {       prob <- if (r_to == r_from) stay_prob[p] else disperse_prob[p]       sim_list$Movement[p, r_from, r_to, , 1, , , ] <- prob     }      # Season 2: natal return with straying     for (r_to in seq_len(sim_list$n_regions)) {       prob <- if (r_to == nr) 1 - non_natal_rate * (sim_list$n_regions - 1) else non_natal_rate       sim_list$Movement[p, r_from, r_to, , 2, , , ] <- prob     }   } }

title: Discard and Retention Modeling
text: estimation model mirrors OM structure estimates key parameters: fishery selectivity (logistic), retention selectivity (asymptotic logistic), survey selectivity (logistic), catchability, recruitment deviations, dead discard rate. function encapsulates full EM setup single simulation replicate.
code: setup_em <- function(sim_obj, sim) {    # get simulation data   sim_data <- simulation_data_to_SPoRC(     sim_env = sim_obj, y = sim_obj$n_years, sim = sim   )    # Model dimensions  input_list <- Setup_Mod_Dim(     years          = 1:sim_obj$n_years,     ages           = 1:sim_obj$n_ages,     lens           = sim_obj$n_lens,     n_regions      = sim_obj$n_regions,     n_sexes        = sim_obj$n_sexes,     n_fish_fleets  = sim_obj$n_fish_fleets,     n_srv_fleets   = sim_obj$n_srv_fleets,     n_pop          = sim_obj$n_pop,     natal_region   = sim_obj$natal_region,     verbose        = FALSE   )    # Recruitment   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Rec(     input_list        = input_list,     do_rec_bias_ramp  = 0,     sigmaR_switch     = 1,     ln_sigmaR         = array(log(0.5), c(2, input_list$data$n_pop,                                           input_list$data$n_regions)),     rec_model         = "mean_rec",     sigmaR_spec       = "fix",     init_age_strc     = 1,     equil_init_age_strc = 2,     ln_global_R0      = log(5)   )    # Biologicals   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Biologicals(     input_list    = input_list,     WAA           = sim_data$WAA,     MatAA         = sim_data$MatAA,     WAA_fish      = sim_data$WAA_fish,     WAA_srv       = sim_data$WAA_srv,     fit_lengths   = 0,     AgeingError   = sim_data$AgeingError,     M_spec        = "fix",     Fixed_natmort = array(0.3, dim = c(input_list$data$n_pop,                                        input_list$data$n_regions,                                        length(input_list$data$years),                                        length(input_list$data$ages),                                        input_list$data$n_sexes))   )    # Tagging and movement (none)   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Tagging(input_list = input_list, use_conv_fish_tagging = 0)   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Movement(     input_list         = input_list,     use_fixed_movement = 1,     Fixed_Movement     = NA,     do_recruits_move   = 0   )    # Catch, fishing mortality, and discards   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Catch_and_F(     input_list     = input_list,     ObsCatch       = sim_data$ObsCatch,     UseCatch       = sim_data$UseCatch,     Use_F_pen      = 1,     sigmaC_spec    = "fix",     ln_sigmaC      = sim_data$ln_sigmaC,     ln_sigmaF      = array(log(1), dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions,                                            input_list$data$n_seas,                                            input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),          # Discard data (discard units are biomass fractions as default)     ObsDiscard     = sim_data$ObsDiscard, # observed discards     UseDiscard     = sim_data$UseDiscard, # using discards     sigma_dmr_spec = "fix", # code: raw_catch <- data.frame(   year = 2016:2020,   fleet = 1,   catch_mt = c(120, 135, 98, 150, 142) ) raw_catch ObsCatch <- array(0, dim = c(n_regions, length(years), n_seas, n_fish_fleets))  for (i in seq_len(nrow(raw_catch))) {   yr_idx <- match(raw_catch$year[i], years)   ObsCatch[1, yr_idx, 1, raw_catch$fleet[i]] <- raw_catch$catch_mt[i] }  ObsCatch[1, , 1, 1] UseCatch <- array(0, dim = dim(ObsCatch)) UseCatch[ObsCatch > 0] <- 1

text: Builds sparse \((n_{\text{ages}} \times n_{\text{yrs}}) \times (n_{\text{ages}} \times n_{\text{yrs}})\) precision matrix \(Q\) Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) simultaneous autoregressive (SAR) structure across three biological dimensions: age, year, cohort (age-year diagonal). matrix constructed via path-matrix factorisation \(Q = (- B)^\top \Omega^{-1} (- B)\), \(B\) encodes partial correlations \(\Omega\) diagonal variance matrix. Two variance parameterisations supported: marginal (stationary) conditional (non-stationary).

Partial correlation along year dimension (.e., adjacent years within age). pcorr_cohort Numeric. Partial correlation along cohort diagonal (.e., \((-1, y-1)\) \((, y)\) cell). ln_var_value Numeric. text: Recruitment distributed spatially using regional recruitment proportions seasonal recruitment timing. Beverton-Holt recruitment used, unfished spawning biomass per recruit (\(S_0\)) calculated internally projecting single recruit full seasonal population dynamics, including movement mortality. Two recruitment formulations supported. **Mean recruitment** recruitment_model = 0, recruitment constant: $$R_{p,r} = R_{0,p} \times RecProp_{p,r}$$ recruitment distributed spatially according rec_region_prop. **Beverton-Holt recruitment** recruitment_model = 1, recruitment follows Beverton-Holt relationship: $$ R = \frac{4hR_0SSB}{(1-h)S_0 + (5h-1)SSB} $$ : \(SSB\) spawning biomass lagged rec_lag seasons   (, rec_lag = 0, current year's spawning biomass,   see rec_lag parameter ) \(S_0\) unfished spawning biomass per recruit \(h\) steepness **Ricker recruitment** recruitment_model = 2, recruitment follows Ricker relationship, written depletion form used EBS pollock assessment (2024, SrType = 1): $$ R = R_0 \frac{SSB}{S_0} \exp\left(\alpha \left(1 - \frac{SSB}{S_0}\right)\right), \quad \alpha = \log\left(\frac{4h}{1-h}\right) $$ curve passes \((S_0, R_0)\) construction. Note \(\alpha\) set Ricker carries compensation ratio Beverton-Holt \(h\), rather textbook definition \(R(0.2 S_0) = h R_0\). Steepness therefore interchangeable two curves: Ricker gives \(R(0.2S_0)/R_0 = 0.2(4h/(1-h))^{0.8}\), exceeds \(h\) bounded 1. \(S_0\) (age-composition spawning biomass per recruit generally) depend rec_lag; pure per-recruit, equilibrium quantity. recruit age class (first age) always included sum; rec_lag = 0, maturity age required exactly zero (validated setup Setup_Mod_Biologicals/Setup_Sim_Biologicals), contributes nothing regardless. Spawning biomass per recruit (\(S_0\)) computed internally projecting single recruit ages seasons unfished fished conditions. algorithm: Allocates recruit across regions seasons. Applies seasonal movement. Computes spawning biomass spawning season. Solves plus group analytically using annual transition matrices. multiple populations modeled, recruitment population depends spawning biomass natal region. title: Calculate Selectivity — Get_Selex
text: Selex_Model Integer specifying selectivity model: 0 Logistic (b50, slope): \(1 / (1 + \exp(-k(\text{bin} - b_{50})))\) 1 Gamma-shaped dome (bin--peak \(b_{\max}\), curvature \(\delta\)). 2 Power function (monotonic decreasing): \(1 / \text{bin}^{\text{power}}\). 3 Logistic (b50, b95 parameterization). 4 Double-normal dome plateau flexible tails (6 parameters). 5 Non-parametric selectivity: bin-level logit parameters mapped via plogis,            optionally modified time-varying deviations. 6 Logistic selectivity asymptote:            \(\alpha / (1 + \exp(-k(\text{bin} - b_{50})))\).            Allows maximum selectivity \(\alpha \(0,1)\). 7 Logistic selectivity asymptote (b50, b95 parameterization):            \(\alpha / (1 + 19^{(b_{50} - \text{bin})/b_{95}})\).            Equivalent Model 3 scaled asymptote \(\alpha\). 9 Non-parametric selectivity log scale, standardized            year's selectivity averages one across bins. Differs            model 5 respects: 5 bounds every raw value            one plogis standardizes years bins            jointly, whereas 9 leaves scale free centers within            year. 8 Bicubic spline bin-node x year-node grid (see            Wbin_bicubic, Wyr_bicubic). One generalized form            covers three cases depending caller constructs            node grid interpolation weights: single smooth bin x            year surface (bicubic), time-invariant bin-spline            (n_yr_nodes == 1), bin-spline re-fit            independently within several year blocks            (n_yr_nodes == 1 within SPoRC's existing            selectivity blocks). TimeVary_Model deviation            layering applies model. TimeVary_Model Integer specifying temporal structure: 0 time variation. 1 IID deviations applied multiplicatively model parameters. 2 Random walk deviations applied multiplicatively model parameters. 3 3D GMRF (marginal variance): deviations applied multiplicatively bin level. 4 3D GMRF (conditional variance): deviations applied multiplicatively bin level. 5 Separable 2D AR(1): deviations applied multiplicatively bin level. pars Numeric vector log-scale selectivity parameters. Parameters exponentiated transformed depending model specification: Model 0 c(ln_b50, ln_slope) Model 1 c(ln_bmax, ln_delta) Model 2 c(ln_power) Model 3 c(ln_b50, ln_b95) Model 4 c(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6) Model 5 c(logit_sel_1, ..., logit_sel_nbins) Model 6 c(logit_alpha, ln_b50, ln_k) Model 7 c(logit_alpha, ln_b50, ln_b95) Model 9 c(ln_sel_1, ..., ln_sel_nbins) Model 8 Flattened bin-node x year-node log-selectivity grid,       length ncol(Wyr_bicubic) * ncol(Wbin_bicubic), filled       column-major ncol(Wyr_bicubic) (rows, year nodes)       ncol(Wbin_bicubic) (columns, bin nodes) matrix. ln_seldevs Array log-scale selectivity deviations dimension   [n_regions, n_years, n_parameters_or_bins, n_sexes, 1]. TimeVary_Model = 1-2: deviations apply selectivity parameters   natural scale exponentiation. TimeVary_Model = 3-5: deviations apply multiplicatively   bin level constructed selectivity curve. Selex_Model = 5: deviations act directly bin-level logit   selectivity parameters prior logistic transformation. Region Integer region index. Year Integer year index (absolute, .e. row index Wyr_bicubic). used directly Selex_Model == 8; otherwise used index ln_seldevs. Bin Numeric vector bins (ages lengths). Sex Integer sex index. Wbin_bicubic Numeric length(Bin) x n_bin_nodes natural cubic spline weight matrix (see Get_Natural_Cubic_Spline_Weights), mapping bin-node log-selectivity values onto Bin. used Selex_Model == 8; ignored (may NULL) otherwise. Zero padding unused columns (e.g. shared parameter array padded common width across fleets/blocks) contributes nothing, since multiplied zero. Wyr_bicubic Numeric n_yrs_total x n_yr_nodes interpolation weight matrix mapping year-node log-selectivity values onto every absolute model year (rows beyond fitted block typically constructed hold boundary node constant). Row Year used call. used Selex_Model == 8; ignored (may NULL) otherwise. single-column matrix -1s (n_yr_nodes == 1) yields time-invariant bin-spline, since every year maps onto single node. n_bin_nodes_bicubic, n_yr_nodes_bicubic Integer. fleet/block's true number bin nodes / year nodes. used Selex_Model == 8. title: Calculate Selectivity — Get_Selex
text: TimeVary_Model = 0, base parametric form evaluated. TimeVary_Model = 1-2, deviations modify model parameters multiplicatively natural scale transformation. TimeVary_Model = 3-5, deviations act directly constructed selectivity curve multiplicative log-normal perturbations: $$\text{selex} = \text{selex} \cdot \exp(\delta_{r,y,b,s})$$. Selex_Model = 5, selectivity fully non-parametric: bin-specific logit parameters optionally adjusted time-varying deviations transformed via: $$\text{selex}_b = \text{logit}^{-1}(\eta_b)$$. Selex_Model = 9, selectivity likewise fully non-parametric held log scale standardized within year: $$\text{selex}_b = \exp(\eta_b) / \overline{\exp(\eta)}$$. differences among \(\eta\) within year identified, level \(\eta\) free absorbed catchability fishing mortality. Models 6 7 extend logistic selectivity introducing asymptote parameter \(\alpha \(0,1)\) allows selectivity saturate full vulnerability.

code: Get_sel_PE_loglik(   PE_model,   PE_pars,   ln_devs,   map_sel_devs,   min_sel_devs_shared_bins,   rw_init_sigma = 5 )

title: Compute Selectivity Process Error Log-Likelihood (Positive Scale) — Get_sel_PE_loglik
text: PE_model Integer specifying process error structure: 1 = IID: deviations drawn independently \(N(0, \sigma^2)\). 2 = Random walk: deviations follow first-order random walk initialized     diffuse prior (\(\sigma = 5\)) y = 1. 3 = 3D GMRF marginal variance parameterization. 4 = 3D GMRF conditional variance parameterization. 5 = Separable 2D AR(1) across bins years. PE_pars Array process error parameters dimensioned   [1, par_index, sex, 1]. par_index slot meaning   depends PE_model: Models 1-2: [1,1,s,1] = log standard deviation (\(\log \sigma\))     sex s, indexed bin/age. Models 3-4: [1,1,s,1] = unconstrained partial correlation age/bin;     [1,2,s,1] = unconstrained partial correlation year;     [1,3,s,1] = unconstrained partial correlation cohort;     [1,4,s,1] = log variance. Model 5: [1,1,s,1] = unconstrained bin correlation (transformed via     \(2/(1+e^{-2x})-1\)); [1,2,s,1] = unconstrained year correlation;     [1,4,s,1] = log standard deviation. ln_devs Array log-scale selectivity deviations dimensioned [1, year, bin, sex, 1]. map_sel_devs Integer array dimensioned [fleet, year, bin, sex] mapping deviations unique estimated parameters. Shared deviations carry integer value; NA entries treated fixed excluded likelihood evaluation. min_sel_devs_shared_bins Integer vector. Indices reference (minimum) bin within shared deviation group, used subset bin dimension evaluating GMRF 2D AR(1) likelihoods (PE models 3-5). bin sharing specified, defaults 1:n_bins (.e., bins included). rw_init_sigma Standard deviation given first year random walk. number (5 default) leaves year effectively unconstrained; NA starts walk zero sigma instead.

title: Compute Selectivity Process Error Log-Likelihood (Positive Scale) — Get_sel_PE_loglik
text: Numeric scalar: positive log-likelihood contribution selectivity   process error. Negated externally form negative log-likelihood.

title: Compute Selectivity Process Error Log-Likelihood (Positive Scale) — Get_sel_PE_loglik
text: function supports: IID process error Random walk process error 3D Gaussian Markov Random Field (GMRF) models (marginal conditional variance) Separable 2D AR(1) models Note: returned value positive log-likelihood scale. must negated obtain negative log-likelihood contribution, handled outside function.

code: Setup_Mod_Biologicals(   input_list,   WAA,   WAA_fish = NULL,   WAA_srv = NULL,   MatAA,   addtocomp = 0.001,   comp_const_obs = 1,   addtofishidx = 1e-04,   addtosrvidx = 1e-04,   addtotag = 1e-10,   AgeingError = NULL,   Use_M_prior = 0,   M_prior = NA,   fit_lengths = 0,   SizeAgeTrans = NA,   M_spec = "est_ln_M",   M_popblk_spec = "constant",   M_ageblk_spec = "constant",   M_regionblk_spec = "constant",   M_yearblk_spec = "constant",   M_sexblk_spec = "constant",   Fixed_natmort = NULL,   ... )

title: Set up biological inputs for the estimation model — Setup_Mod_Biologicals
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists, returned Setup_Mod_Dim. WAA Numeric array spawning weight--age dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. Used compute spawning stock biomass. Also serves fallback WAA_fish WAA_srv NULL. WAA_fish Numeric array fishery weight--age dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. NULL (default), WAA broadcast across fishery fleets. WAA_srv Numeric array survey weight--age dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets]. NULL (default), WAA broadcast across survey fleets. MatAA Numeric array maturity--age proportions (\(\[0,1]\)) dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. rec_lag = 0 (age-0 recruitment, set via Setup_Mod_Rec), maturity recruit age (first age class) must exactly 0 populations, regions, years, seasons, sexes, error raised otherwise. Requires Setup_Mod_Rec called first rec_lag already set. addtocomp Small constant added composition proportions likelihood evaluation avoid log(0). Default 1e-3. Ignored logistic-normal likelihood specified, family handles zeros internally. comp_const_obs Integer switch (0 1) controlling addtocomp applied multinomial kernel, constant tuned. 1 (default) adds observed proportions weight multinomial well inside logarithms, kernel stationary exactly pred = obs. 0 weights raw observed proportions, ADMB templates , displaces expected composition data roughly n * addtocomp. difference matters effective sample sizes large: EBS pollock bridge, switching 0 1 moves estimated SSB median 8.8 percent. Use 0 reproducing ADMB model. addtofishidx Small constant added fishery indices. Default 1e-4. addtosrvidx Small constant added survey indices. Default 1e-4. addtotag Small constant added tag recovery observations. Default 1e-10. AgeingError Ageing error (age-age transition) array mapping true modelled ages observed age bins. Accepted forms: 2D matrix [n_model_ages × n_obs_ages] Time-invariant ageing error;     replicated internally across years. 3D array [n_years × n_model_ages × n_obs_ages] Time-varying ageing error. NULL (default) identity matrix constructed, assuming modelled     observed age bins identical. observed bins subset modelled     ages (e.g., observed ages 2-10 vs. modelled ages 1-10), supply shifted     identity matrix diag(1, n_model_ages)[, obs_age_index]     avoid dimensional mismatch. Use_M_prior Integer flag apply lognormal prior natural mortality. 0 = prior (default); 1 = apply prior. M_prior Data frame prior hyperparameters natural mortality, one row per unique block combination. Required columns: popblk, regionblk, yearblk, ageblk, sexblk Block indices identifying parameter prior applies . mu Prior mean natural (untransformed) space. sd Prior standard deviation. Example single shared prior: used Use_M_prior = 1. fit_lengths Integer flag fitting length compositions. 0 = (default); 1 = yes. Requires valid SizeAgeTrans array. SizeAgeTrans Numeric array size--age transition probabilities (column-stochastic; age column sums 1) dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_lens × n_ages × n_sexes]. Required fit_lengths = 1; ignored otherwise. M_spec Character string controlling natural mortality estimation. One : "est_ln_M" (default) Estimate ln_M across defined blocks. "fix" Fix mortality Fixed_natmort; ln_M parameters     mapped NA passed optimizer. M_popblk_spec Blocking structure ln_M across populations. Either "constant" (default; single shared value) list integer index vectors defining population groups, e.g., list(1, 2) population-specific M. M_ageblk_spec Blocking structure across ages. Either "constant" (default) list integer index vectors, e.g., list(1:5, 6:10). M_regionblk_spec Blocking structure across regions. Either "constant" (default) list integer index vectors, e.g., list(1:3, 4:5). M_yearblk_spec Blocking structure across years. Either "constant" (default) list integer index vectors, e.g., list(1:10, 11:30). M_sexblk_spec Blocking structure across sexes. Either "constant" (default; shared across sexes) list integer index vectors, e.g., list(1, 2) sex-specific M. Fixed_natmort Numeric array fixed natural mortality rates dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_ages × n_sexes]. Note absence n_seas dimension. Required M_spec = "fix"; ignored otherwise. ... Optional starting value overrides passed name. Currently recognised: ln_M Array log-scale starting values natural mortality,     dimensioned [n_popblks × n_regionblks × n_yearblks × n_ageblks × n_sexblks].     Defaults log(0.5) blocks supplied. ... arguments silently ignored M_spec = "fix".

code: Setup_Mod_Catch_and_F(   input_list,   ObsCatch,   UseCatch,   catch_units = array("biom", dim = c(input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),   UseCatch_pop = array(0, dim = c(input_list$data$n_pop, input_list$data$n_regions,     length(input_list$data$years), input_list$data$n_seas,     input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),   ObsCatch_pop = NULL,   Use_F_pen = 1,   sigmaC_spec = "fix",   sigmaC_pop_spec = "fix",   sigmaF_spec = "fix",   Fdev_model = "iid",   Fdev_pen_center = "fixed",   Fdev_rho_spec = "fix",   ln_F_mean_spec = "est",   ObsDiscard = NULL,   UseDiscard = array(0, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions, length(input_list$data$years),     input_list$data$n_seas, input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),   discard_units = array("biom_frac", dim = c(input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),   UseDiscard_pop = array(0, dim = c(input_list$data$n_pop, input_list$data$n_regions,     length(input_list$data$years), input_list$data$n_seas,     input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),   ObsDiscard_pop = NULL,   Use_dmr_pen = 0,   sigmaD_spec = "fix",   sigmaD_pop_spec = "fix",   sigma_dmr_spec = "fix",   dmr_mean_spec = "fix",   dmr_dev_spec = "fix",   ... )

title: Set up fishing mortality, discard mortality, and catch observation inputs — Setup_Mod_Catch_and_F
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists, returned upstream setup functions. ObsCatch Observed aggregated catch array [n_regions x n_years x n_seas x n_fish_fleets]. Values units specified catch_units. cell UseCatch == 0 (population-specific catch used), NA entry treated genuinely missing observation; fishing assumed continued Fmort/ ln_F_devs estimated normally year, whereas true recorded value (typically 0) treated real closure: Fmort forced zero deviation estimated. See Get_Fdev_PE_loglik. UseCatch Binary indicator array [n_regions x n_years x n_seas x n_fish_fleets] controlling aggregated catch observations enter likelihood whether ln_F_devs estimated cell. 1 = use; 0 = exclude, unless ObsCatch NA cell (see ObsCatch ), case ln_F_devs still estimated ordinary active year despite fit observation. catch_units Character array [n_fish_fleets] specifying catch units per fleet. "biom" = biomass (default); "abd" = abundance. Converted internally 0/1 integer codes. UseCatch_pop Binary indicator array [n_pop x n_regions x n_years x n_seas x n_fish_fleets] controlling population-specific catch observations enter likelihood. 1 = use; 0 = exclude. ObsCatch_pop Observed population-specific catch array [n_pop x n_regions x n_years x n_seas x n_fish_fleets]. Values units specified catch_units. Use_F_pen Integer flag applying fishing mortality penalty penalise large deviations ln_F_devs. 1 = apply (default); 0 = apply. sigmaC_spec Character string specifying sharing structure ln_sigmaC (aggregated catch observation error SD). Default "fix" holds ln_sigmaC starting value (log(0.01) unless overridden via ...). Sharing options follow convention "est_shared_<dims>" <dims> underscore-separated list dimensions collapse: "r" (regions), "y" (years), "seas" (seasons), "f" (fleets), combination (e.g., "est_shared_r_y", "est_shared_r_y_seas_f"). Use "est_all" fully independent parameter per cell. warning issued "fix" selected without providing starting value .... sigmaC_pop_spec Character string specifying sharing structure ln_sigmaC_pop (population-specific catch observation error SD). Default "fix" holds ln_sigmaC_pop starting value (log(0.01) unless overridden via ...). Sharing options follow convention sigmaC_spec additional population dimension: e.g., "est_shared_pop" shares across populations, "est_shared_pop_r" shares across populations regions, "est_shared_pop_r_y_seas_f" collapses dimensions single parameter. warning issued "fix" selected without providing starting value .... sigmaF_spec Character string specifying sharing structure ln_sigmaF (fishing mortality process error SD). Default "fix" holds ln_sigmaF starting value (log(1), .e., \(\sigma_F = 1\), unless overridden via ...). warning issued "fix" selected without providing starting value .... Fdev_model Character string specifying process error structure ln_F_devs. One "iid" (default; independent deviations), "rw" (random walk; first catch-active year per region/season/fleet initialized diffuse \(N(0,5)\) prior), "ar1" (first-order autoregressive; first catch-active year drawn stationary marginal distribution, Fdev_rho_spec controls AR1 correlation parameter). Catch-active years need contiguous "rw" "ar1": transition two active years spanning gap \(d\) closed years taken elapsed gap directly (marginal transition estimating deviations closed years integrating , without actually estimating ), see Get_Fdev_PE_loglik. warning issued "rw" "ar1" selected Use_F_pen = 0 (penalty never evaluated, process structure effect), sigmaF_spec = "fix" (process error SD estimated), ("ar1") Fdev_rho_spec = "fix" (correlation estimated), may intentional, common oversights switching away "iid". Fdev_pen_center fishing mortality deviation penalty centred. "fixed" (default) centres zero, constraining level spread deviations. "own_mean" centres mean estimated deviations, penalizing spread leaving level free, sum squares series' mean amounts . mean-plus-deviations parameterization level already carried ln_F_mean, "own_mean" avoids penalizing twice; note also leaves ln_F_mean deviations' level mutually unidentified unless one fixed, ln_F_mean_spec = "fix" . Fdev_rho_spec Character string specifying sharing structure AR1 correlation parameter Fdev_rho, following convention sigmaF_spec. used Fdev_model = "ar1"; ignored (mapped entirely NA) otherwise. ln_F_mean_spec Character string, "est" (default, previous behaviour) "fix". "fix" maps ln_F_mean starting value, defaults 0 spec unless supplied ..., deviations carry log fishing mortality: F = exp(ln_F_devs), follows free annual log-F parameterization. must paired Fdev_pen_center = "own_mean" (penalize spread deviations' mean), Fdev_model = "rw", Use_F_pen = 0: "iid" "ar1" penalty centred fixed zero mean shrink deviations toward F = 1, combination rejected setup. "est" keeps mean-plus-deviations form, "iid" penalty shrinks year toward estimated average F. ObsDiscard Observed aggregated discard array [n_regions x n_years x n_seas x n_fish_fleets]. Values units specified discard_units. Default: NULL (discard observations). UseDiscard Binary indicator array [n_regions x n_years x n_seas x n_fish_fleets] controlling aggregated discard observations enter likelihood. 1 = use; 0 = exclude. Default: zeros. discard_units Character array [n_fish_fleets] specifying discard units per fleet. "abd" = abundance (0), "biom" = biomass (1), "abd_frac" = abundance fraction (2), "biom_frac" = biomass fraction (3, default). Converted internally integer codes. UseDiscard_pop Binary indicator array [n_pop x n_regions x n_years x n_seas x n_fish_fleets] controlling population-specific discard observations enter likelihood. 1 = use; 0 = exclude. Default: zeros. ObsDiscard_pop Observed population-specific discard array [n_pop x n_regions x n_years x n_seas x n_fish_fleets]. Values units specified discard_units. Default: NULL (population-specific discard observations). Use_dmr_pen Integer flag applying discard mortality rate penalty penalise large deviations logit_dmr_devs. 1 = apply; 0 = apply (default). Must 1 dmr_dev_spec = "est_all" 0 dmr_dev_spec = "fix". sigmaD_spec Character string specifying sharing structure ln_sigmaD (aggregated discard observation error SD). Default "fix" holds ln_sigmaD starting value (log(0.01) unless overridden via ...). Sharing options follow convention sigmaC_spec. warning issued "fix" selected without providing starting value .... sigmaD_pop_spec Character string specifying sharing structure ln_sigmaD_pop (population-specific discard observation error SD). Default "fix" holds ln_sigmaD_pop starting value (log(0.01) unless overridden via ...). Sharing options follow convention sigmaC_pop_spec. warning issued "fix" selected without providing starting value .... sigma_dmr_spec Character string specifying sharing structure ln_sigma_dmr (discard mortality rate process error SD). Default "fix" holds ln_sigma_dmr starting value (log(1) unless overridden via ...). Sharing options follow convention sigmaF_spec. warning issued "fix" selected without providing starting value .... dmr_mean_spec Character string specifying sharing/estimation structure logit_dmr_mean (logit-scale mean discard mortality rate). Default "fix" holds starting value (0, .e., DMR = 0.5 natural scale, unless overridden via ...). See do_dmr_mean_mapping sharing options. dmr_dev_spec Character string specifying sharing/estimation structure logit_dmr_devs (logit-scale annual discard mortality rate deviations). Default "fix" holds deviations zero (unless overridden via ...). Use "est_all" estimate deviation every fished cell; requires Use_dmr_pen = 1. See do_dmr_dev_mapping sharing options. ... Optional starting value overrides catch discard related parameters.

Set NULL length data modelled; scalar placeholder 1 stored internally case. n_pop Positive integer. Number distinct populations (default 1). Populations can independent stock-recruit relationships natal regions share spatial domain defined n_regions. natal_region Integer vector length n_pop mapping population natal region (1-indexed). Defaults applied NULL: n_regions == 1: populations assigned region 1. n_pop == n_regions: one--one mapping (1:n_pop). n_pop == 1: assigned region 1. Must supplied explicitly n_pop > 1, n_pop != n_regions, n_regions > 1, sensible default exists populations must share natal region. n_seas Positive integer. Number seasons within year (default 1). seasdur Numeric vector length n_seas giving duration season fraction year (values sum 1). Defaults 1 single season rep(1 / n_seas, n_seas) equal-length seasons n_seas > 1. n_regions Positive integer. Number spatial regions. n_sexes Integer. Number sexes; must 1 (sex-aggregated) 2 (sex-structured). n_fish_fleets Positive integer. Number fishery fleets. n_srv_fleets Positive integer. Number survey fleets. n_proj_yrs_devs Non-negative integer. Number projection years deviation parameters (ln_RecDevs, move_devs, ln_fishsel_devs, ln_srvsel_devs) allocated. title: Set up discards, fishery index, age composition, and length composition inputs — Setup_Mod_FishIdx_and_Comps
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists, returned upstream setup functions. ObsFishIdx Observed fishery CPUE biomass index array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. ObsFishIdx_SE Standard errors ObsFishIdx log scale, dimensions ObsFishIdx. ObsFishIdx_pop Observed population-specific fishery index array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. ObsFishIdx_pop_SE Lognormal standard errors ObsFishIdx_pop, dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. UseFishIdx_pop Binary indicator array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. 1 = include population-specific index likelihood; 0 = exclude. Default: zeros. fish_idx_type Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying index type fleet. "biom" = biomass; "abd" = abundance; "none" = index fleet. t_fish Array [n_regions x n_seas x n_fish_fleets] giving fishery index timing: fraction season elapsed index observed. Numbers age decayed exp(-t_fish * ZAA) index formed, convention t_srv uses surveys. Defaults 0 (start season), model argument existed; set 0.5 mid-season index. UseFishIdx Binary indicator array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. 1 = include index likelihood; 0 = exclude. ObsFishAgeComps Observed fishery age composition array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Values may raw counts proportions; proportions, supply ISS_FishAgeComps explicitly. UseFishAgeComps Binary indicator array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. 1 = fit age compositions; 0 = exclude. ISS_FishAgeComps Input sample size array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. NULL (default), computed automatically summing ObsFishAgeComps within year-fleet-season-region cell according FishAgeComps_Type. ObsFishLenComps Observed fishery length composition array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_lens × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. required input_list$data$fit_lengths == 1. UseFishLenComps Binary indicator array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. 1 = fit length compositions; 0 = exclude. ISS_FishLenComps Input sample size array length compositions [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. NULL (default), derived automatically ObsFishLenComps. FishAgeComps_LikeType Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying likelihood fishery age compositions. Options: "Multinomial", "Dirichlet-Multinomial", "iid-Logistic-Normal", "1d-Logistic-Normal", "2d-Logistic-Normal", "none". FishLenComps_LikeType FishAgeComps_LikeType length compositions. FishAgeComps_Type Character vector defining age composition structure (aggregation level) fleet time period. element must follow format "<type>_Year_<start>-<end>_Fleet_<f>" "<type>_Year_<start>-terminal_Fleet_<f>". Valid types: "agg" Aggregated across regions sexes     (incompatible "2d-Logistic-Normal"). "spltRspltS" Split region sex. "spltRjntS" Split region, summed jointly across sexes. "none" composition data fleet period. Example: c("spltRjntS_Year_1-10_Fleet_1", "agg_Year_11-terminal_Fleet_1"). FishLenComps_Type format options FishAgeComps_Type applied length compositions. ObsFishAgeComps_pop Observed population-specific fishery age composition array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Required element UseFishAgeComps_pop 1. UseFishAgeComps_pop Binary indicator array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. 1 = fit population-specific age compositions; 0 = exclude. Default: zeros. ISS_FishAgeComps_pop Input sample size array population-specific age compositions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. NULL (default), computed automatically summing ObsFishAgeComps_pop within population-year-fleet-season-region cell according FishAgeComps_pop_Type. ObsFishLenComps_pop Observed population-specific fishery length composition array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_lens × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Required input_list$data$fit_lengths == 1 element UseFishLenComps_pop 1. UseFishLenComps_pop Binary indicator array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. 1 = fit population-specific length compositions; 0 = exclude. Default: zeros. ISS_FishLenComps_pop Input sample size array population-specific length compositions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. NULL (default), derived automatically ObsFishLenComps_pop. FishAgeComps_pop_LikeType Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying likelihood population-specific fishery age compositions. options FishAgeComps_LikeType. Default: "none" fleets. FishLenComps_pop_LikeType Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying likelihood population-specific fishery length compositions. options FishLenComps_LikeType. Default: "none" fleets. FishAgeComps_pop_Type Character vector defining composition structure population-specific age compositions. format options FishAgeComps_Type. Default: "none" fleets across years. FishLenComps_pop_Type Character vector defining composition structure population-specific length compositions. format options FishLenComps_Type. Default: "none" fleets across years. fish_idx_ages Per-fleet selection ages contribute index total. Either list one element per fishery fleet, element vector ages NULL ages, array [n_ages x n_fish_fleets] 0/1 weights. Default NULL uses every age every fleet. fleet's compositions unaffected. FishAgeComps_bins age bins fishery fleet's age composition fitted . Supply list one element per fleet, vector age indices NULL ages, [n_ages x n_fish_fleets] array 0/1 weights. observed expected compositions restricted named bins renormalized within , excluded bins left likelihood rather forced explained; fleet ages part age range fitted. Indices refer observed bins, ageing error mapped model ages onto observed ones. Every fleet must retain least one bin. Default NULL, fits ages fleets. FishIdx_LikeType Character vector [n_fish_fleets] giving error structure fishery index. Options "lognormal" (default, observation standard errors log scale), "normal" (arithmetic scale), "mvn" (multivariate normal arithmetic scale using fixed covariance supplied FishIdx_Cov). One-step-ahead residuals available lognormal fleets. fleet's population-specific index stream follows choice "lognormal" "normal", stays lognormal "mvn", whose covariance describes regional series . FishIdx_Cov List one element per fishery fleet holding fixed covariance matrix fleets using "mvn", NULL otherwise. matrix must square one row per observation fleet fits, ordered observations appear scanning fleet's UseFishIdx slice array order. ObsFishAgeComps_discard Observed fishery age composition discards [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Structure must match ObsFishAgeComps. UseFishAgeComps_discard Binary indicator array discard age compositions [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. 1 = include discard age compositions likelihood; 0 = exclude. ISS_FishAgeComps_discard Input sample size array discard age compositions [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. NULL, derived automatically ObsFishAgeComps_discard using FishAgeComps_discard_Type. ObsFishLenComps_discard Observed fishery length composition discards [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_lens × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Required input_list$data$fit_lengths == 1. UseFishLenComps_discard Binary indicator array discard length compositions [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. 1 = include discard length compositions likelihood; 0 = exclude. ISS_FishLenComps_discard Input sample size array discard length compositions [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. NULL, derived automatically ObsFishLenComps_discard. FishAgeComps_discard_LikeType Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying likelihood type discard age compositions. Options: "Multinomial" Standard multinomial likelihood "Dirichlet-Multinomial" Overdispersed multinomial "iid-Logistic-Normal" Independent logistic-normal "1d-Logistic-Normal" 1D correlated logistic-normal "2d-Logistic-Normal" 2D correlated logistic-normal "none" discard age composition likelihood FishLenComps_discard_LikeType specification FishAgeComps_discard_LikeType, discard length compositions. FishAgeComps_discard_Type Character vector defining discard age composition structure fleet year block. Format: "<type>_Year_<start>-<end>_Fleet_<f>" "<type>_Year_<start>-terminal_Fleet_<f>". Valid types: "agg" Aggregated across regions sexes "spltRspltS" Split region sex "spltRjntS" Split region, joint across sexes "none" discard age composition FishLenComps_discard_Type format options FishAgeComps_discard_Type, applied discard length compositions. ObsFishAgeComps_discard_pop Observed population-specific discard age composition array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. UseFishAgeComps_discard_pop Binary indicator array population-specific discard age compositions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. ISS_FishAgeComps_discard_pop Input sample size array population-specific discard age compositions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. NULL, computed ObsFishAgeComps_discard_pop. ObsFishLenComps_discard_pop Observed population-specific discard length composition array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_lens × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. UseFishLenComps_discard_pop Binary indicator array population-specific discard length compositions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. ISS_FishLenComps_discard_pop Input sample size array population-specific discard length compositions [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. NULL, derived ObsFishLenComps_discard_pop. FishAgeComps_discard_pop_LikeType Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying likelihood type population-specific discard age compositions. options FishAgeComps_discard_LikeType. FishLenComps_discard_pop_LikeType discard length compositions. FishAgeComps_discard_pop_Type Character vector defining structure population-specific discard age compositions. format FishAgeComps_discard_Type. FishLenComps_discard_pop_Type Character vector defining structure population-specific discard length compositions. format FishLenComps_discard_Type. ... Optional starting value overrides overdispersion correlation parameters.

title: Set up total and retained fishery selectivity and catchability specifications — Setup_Mod_Fishsel_and_Q
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists. cont_tv_fish_sel Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying continuous time-varying selectivity per fleet. element must "<type>_Fleet_<f>". Valid types: "none" continuous time-variation (default). "iid" IID annual deviations selectivity parameters. "rw" Random walk selectivity parameters time. "3dmarg" 3D GMRF marginal variance parameterisation. "3dcond" 3D GMRF conditional variance parameterisation. "2dar1" 2D separable AR1 bin year dimensions. fleet cont_tv_fish_sel != "none", fishsel_pe_pars_spec fish_sel_devs_spec must also provided. fish_sel_blocks Character vector defining discrete selectivity time blocks per fleet. element follows "Block_<b>_Year_<s>-<e>_Fleet_<f>" "Block_<b>_Year_<s>-terminal_Fleet_<f>". Use "none_Fleet_<f>" (default) single constant block. Blocks must non-overlapping together span model years specified fleet. Mutually exclusive cont_tv_fish_sel != "none" fleet. fish_sel_model Character vector specifying selectivity functional form fleet (optionally time block). element must follow one : "<model>_Fleet_<f>": single form years fleet f. "<model>_Fleet_<f>_Block_<b>": form specific block b     fleet f, defined fish_sel_blocks. Available models: "logist1" Logistic \(a_{50}\) slope \(k\) (2 parameters). "logist2" Logistic \(a_{50}\) \(a_{95}\) (2 parameters). "gamma" Dome-shaped gamma \(a_{max}\) \(\delta\) (2 parameters). "exponential" Exponential single power parameter (1 parameter). "dbnrml" Double-normal 6 parameters. "nonpar" Non-parametric selectivity defined discrete age length bins, selectivity estimated independent parameters (grouped bins specified via nonparametric bin mapping). fixed functional form imposed. "asymplogist1" Logistic selectivity \(a_{50}\) slope \(k\) asymptotic control (3 parameters). "asymplogist2" Logistic selectivity \(a_{50}\) \(a_{95}\) asymptotic control (3 parameters). "bicubic" Bicubic spline bin-node x year-node grid     (see Get_Selex, Selex_Model == 8). Specified     "bicubic_Bin_<n_bin_nodes>_Yr_<n_yr_nodes>_Fleet_x" (optionally     _Block_k). One generalized form covers smooth bin x year     surface (n_yr_nodes > 1), time-invariant bin-spline     (n_yr_nodes == 1), bin-spline re-fit independently     per year-block (n_yr_nodes == 1 within several blocks     defined via fish_sel_blocks). optional _SelStyr_<year>     suffix (calendar year within block) restricts actual spline     fit SelStyr:block-end; years within block     SelStyr held constant SelStyr year's fitted     curve, rather fitting surface whole block.     optional _NSelBins_<n> suffix restricts actual spline fit     first n bins (ages lengths, per fish_selex_type);     bins beyond n held constant last fitted bin's     curve. See model equations vignette mathematical definitions. Use_fish_q_prior Integer flag. 1 = apply lognormal priors catchability; 0 = priors (default). Requires fish_q_prior. fish_q_prior Data frame catchability prior hyperparameters. Required columns: region, fleet, block (block index), mu (prior mean natural scale), sd (prior SD log scale). row specifies \(\text{Normal}(\log(\mu), \sigma)\) prior one catchability parameter. used Use_fish_q_prior = 1. fish_q_blocks Character vector defining catchability time blocks per fleet, using format fish_sel_blocks. Default "none_Fleet_<f>" gives single constant block. fish_q_type Character vector length n_fish_fleets controlling catchability obtained. "est" (default) estimates ln_fish_q. "arith" concentrates likelihood ratio mean observed mean predicted index, "geo" log scale exp(mean(log(obs) - log(pred))). analytic forms solve one catchability per region fleet using years observations, ignore block structure, fix fleet's ln_fish_q regardless fish_q_spec. fish_q_cov_dat Named list numeric vectors (length = n_years) containing covariate time series referenced fish_q_formula. vectors must length contain missing values; set values 0 years fishery index active. Default NULL. fish_q_formula Named list one-sided formulas, one element per fleet requiring catchability covariates, referencing series fish_q_cov_dat. NULL (default) excludes covariate effects. fishsel_pe_pars_spec Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying estimation structure selectivity process error hyperparameters. Required fleet continuous time-variation. See do_sel_pe_pars_mapping options. fish_fixed_sel_pars_spec Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying fixed-effect selectivity parameters estimated. See do_fixed_sel_pars_mapping options ("est_all", "est_shared_r", "est_shared_s", "est_shared_r_s", "est_shared_f_x", "fix"). fish_q_spec Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying catchability estimation structure. See do_q_mapping options ("est_all", "est_shared_r", "fix"). fish_sel_devs_spec Character vector length n_fish_fleets specifying estimation structure annual selectivity deviations. Required fleet continuous time-variation. See do_sel_devs_mapping options including age-sharing options semi-parametric forms. corr_opt_semipar Character vector length n_fish_fleets controlling correlation components suppress semi-parametric (3D GMRF 2D AR1) time-varying selectivity. Set NA (default) suppression. See do_sel_pe_pars_mapping valid suppression codes. Cohort-correlation options invalid "2dar1". Use_fish_selex_prior Integer flag. 1 = apply lognormal priors selectivity parameters; 0 = priors (default). Requires fish_selex_prior. fish_selex_prior Data frame selectivity prior hyperparameters, one row per prior. Required columns: region, fleet, block, sex, par (parameter index within functional form), mu, sd, plus optional type giving row's target: "par" (default column absent) lognormal prior one fixed selectivity parameter, mu natural scale sd log scale; "value" normal prior realized selectivity value one bin, natural scale, par instead names bin (ages lengths per fish_selex_type) value read first model year block. "value" row constrains derived selectivity value rather parameters, matching ADMB convention pinning selectivity reference age near one, set independent parameter priors can express. used Use_fish_selex_prior = 1. Use_fish_selex_penalty Integer (0/1). Whether centering penalty applied sets fishery selectivity fixed-effect parameters. Default 0. fish_sel_bin_dev_bins List one element per fishery fleet naming bins fleet overrides, NULL fleets overrides (e.g. list(1, NULL) frees bin 1 fleet 1 ). overridden bin takes freely estimated annual value \(\exp(\epsilon_{y,b})\) place whatever functional form produced, applied every transformation including standardization. rest curve keeps parametric shape. Default NULL. fishsel_pe_wt Numeric vector length n_fish_fleets. Per-fleet multiplier fishery selectivity process error likelihood. Default 1 every fleet. 0 skips fleet's process error likelihood altogether, deviations stay estimated enter objective data explicit smoothness centering penalties, several existing assessments constrain . Values 0 1 make estimated process error sigma reinterpretable, prefer 0 1 unless deliberately -weighting. Applies ln_fishsel_devs; bin-override deviations carry process error affected. fishsel_rw_init_sigma Numeric vector length n_fish_fleets. Standard deviation given first year "rw" deviation series. Default 5, leaves year effectively free. NA instead starts walk zero walk's estimated sigma, making first year smooth every later step. title: Set up movement model inputs and parameter structures — Setup_Mod_Movement
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists, returned upstream setup functions. move_type Integer. Movement model formulation: 0 = unstructured Markov; 1 = CTMC. Default 0. do_recruits_move Integer flag. 0 = age-1 fish move (default); movement deviations CTMC rows minimum age fixed zero. 1 = recruits participate movement. use_fixed_movement Integer flag. 0 = estimate movement (default); 1 = fix movement rates Fixed_Movement map movement parameters NA. Fixed_Movement Numeric array externally supplied movement probability matrices, dimensioned [n_pop × n_regions × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. [n_regions × n_regions] slice must row-stochastic (rows sum 1). Required use_fixed_movement = 1. NA (default), identity matrix (movement) constructed internally. Use_Movement_Prior Integer flag. 1 = apply Dirichlet priors movement row probabilities; 0 = priors (default). Requires Movement_prior. Movement_prior Data frame Dirichlet prior concentration parameters. Required columns: pop, region_from, year, seas, age, sex, alpha, alpha list-column element numeric vector length n_regions giving Dirichlet concentration transitions region_from. Values near 1 uninformative; larger values concentrate prior toward equal movement. used Use_Movement_Prior = 1. Movement_popblk_spec "constant" (default, shared across populations) list integer vectors partitioning populations blocks. Example: list(c(1, 2), 3) shares parameters populations 1 2 estimates separate parameter population 3. Ignored move_type = 1. Movement_ageblk_spec "constant" (default) list integer vectors defining age blocks. Example: list(1:4, 5:10) creates juvenile block (ages 1-4) adult block (ages 5-10). Ignored move_type = 1. Movement_yearblk_spec "constant" (default) list integer vectors defining year blocks discrete structural breaks movement. residual annual variation, use cont_vary_movement instead. Ignored move_type = 1. Movement_seasblk_spec "constant" (default) list integer vectors defining season blocks. Example: list(c(1, 2), c(3, 4)) groups winter/spring summer/fall. Ignored move_type = 1. Movement_sexblk_spec "constant" (default, sex-invariant) list integer vectors defining sex blocks. Example: list(1, 2) estimates sex-specific movement independently. Ignored move_type = 1. cont_vary_movement Character string specifying structure continuous iid movement deviations added top fixed-effect movement surface. Default "none". Options: "none" deviations. "iid_y" Year-varying; shared across pop, age, sex, season. "iid_a" Age-varying; shared across pop, year, sex, season. "iid_y_a" Year \(\times\) age. "iid_y_a_s" Year \(\times\) age \(\times\) sex. "iid_y_seas_a_s" Year \(\times\) season \(\times\) age \(\times\) sex. "iid_p_y", "iid_p_a", "iid_p_y_a", "iid_p_y_a_s", "iid_p_y_seas_a_s" Population-specific analogues . Movement_cont_pe_pars_spec Character string specifying estimation process-error variance cont_vary_movement deviations. One : "none" process-error parameters; use cont_vary_movement = "none". "fix" Parameters initialised estimated; fixes     deviation variance starting value. "est_shared" Single variance estimated, shared across     dimensions. "est_all" variance parameters estimated independently,     dimensioned [n_pop × n_regions × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. ctmc_move_dat Data frame required move_type = 1. row corresponds unique pop-region-year-season-age-sex combination. Required columns: pop, regions, years, seas, ages, sexes, plus covariate columns referenced diffusion_formula preference_formula. Projection years exceeding n_years automatically capped final estimation year prevent spline extrapolation. adjacency_mat Square numeric matrix [n_regions × n_regions] 1 indicating allowed transition 0 indicating direct connection; diagonal 0. Required move_type = 1. move_type = 0 fully connected matrix constructed automatically. area_r Numeric vector length n_regions giving area region, used scale CTMC diffusion rates. Required move_type = 1. Default: rep(1, n_regions). diffusion_formula R formula defining linear predictor CTMC diffusion (\(\theta\)) component (e.g., ~ bs(depth, df = 4)). right-hand-side variables must present ctmc_move_dat. Required move_type = 1. preference_formula R formula defining linear predictor CTMC habitat-preference (taxis, \(\gamma\)) component. variables must present ctmc_move_dat. Required move_type = 1. ctmc_diffusion_bounds Integer flag. 1 = apply bounds diffusion parameters ensure CTMC generator matrix valid Metzler matrix (non-negative -diagonal entries). 0 = bounds (default). move_timing Integer flag setting movement mortality sequenced within season. 0 = movement mortality (default, historical SPoRC behaviour); 1 = mortality movement; 2 = continuous, movement mortality acting simultaneously via matrix exponential \(Q\Delta - \mathrm{diag}(Z)\). move_timing = 2 requires estimated CTMC generator, .e. move_type = 1 use_fixed_movement = 0. ctmc_scale_by_seasdur Integer flag controlling time units CTMC generator. 1 (default) treats \(Q\) annual rate, exponentiating \(Q \cdot \mathrm{seasdur}[s]\) season movement mortality share time units. 0 exponentiates \(Q\) per season regardless duration. effect move_type = 1 n_seas > 1; forced 1 move_timing = 2. ... Optional starting value overrides, passed name. Recognised arguments: move_pars Array [n_pop × n_regions × (n_regions-1) × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. Default: 0 (equal movement logit scale). log_move_diffusion_pars Vector length n_theta. Default: log(0.1). move_preference_pars Vector length n_gamma. Default: 0. move_devs Array [n_pop × n_regions × (n_regions-1) × (n_years + n_proj_yrs_devs) × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. Default: 0. move_pe_pars Array [n_pop × n_regions × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. Default: 0.
